Container.Name: claude-code-linux
Container.Changes: Adds python3, pip and uv; Claude opens maximized on a plain desktop. Initial release: Claude Desktop 2.26454.2 and Claude Code CLI 2.1.294, streamed with Selkies on ghcr.io/selkies-project/selkies/desktop:2.0.0-ubuntu26.04. PUID/PGID 1000/1000 only, /dev/shm 2g, state bind-mounted at /home/ubuntu. See the README for the release, verification and rollback commands.
Container.Overview:
Claude Desktop for Linux (the official Anthropic apt package) and the Claude Code CLI, running as a full Chrome/LXQt desktop streamed to your browser with Selkies. Nothing to install on the client: open the WebUI.
Required first step: the GHCR package is PRIVATE until the redistribution and licensing review is closed. Open the Unraid terminal and run docker login ghcr.io -u YOUR-GITHUB-USERNAME pasting a GitHub personal access token with read:packages when prompted. Without this the pull fails with "denied".
PUID and PGID must BOTH be 1000. The Selkies desktop layer is rootless at uid 1000 and the image refuses any other value with exit code 78; no remap exists. Unraid's own default is 99/100, so leave these fields at 1000.
Basic auth is off by default. Set SELKIES_ENABLE_BASIC_AUTH to true and PASSWD to require the ubuntu login.
Unraid pre-creates the appdata directory as nobody:users (99:100) while the session runs as uid 1000. The container re-chowns /home/ubuntu at every start, so the stock flow works. If a start still reports a write or permission error, run on the Unraid terminal: chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/user/appdata/claude-code-linux
/dev/shm is raised to 2g in ExtraParams because the browsers in this desktop crash on Docker's 64 MB default.
Cowork (the QEMU/KVM virtual machine feature) needs /dev/kvm and /dev/vhost-vsock, which this template does not grant, so Cowork is unsupported. The Claude Code CLI ships in the same image and is the documented fallback.
Video is encoded on the CPU (x264) by default; no GPU or device passthrough is needed. To use an Intel or AMD GPU, add --device=/dev/dri to ExtraParams: Selkies detects the render node at start and encodes H.264, H.265, VP9 and AV1 with VA-API where the GPU supports them (checked on an Intel Arc A380; NVIDIA is untested). No driver install is needed on the Unraid host or in the image: the host kernel's driver is enough, and the image carries the VA-API, Mesa and Vulkan drivers. With a GPU, Claude Desktop renders through ANGLE on Vulkan, which avoids the "XFree86-VidModeExtension missing" and "glXGetMscRateOML failed" lines its default GL backend logs on a virtual X display. python3, pip and uv are installed; what you install with pip --user or uv lives under /home/ubuntu and persists.
Do not expose port 8080 to the Internet: the session holds your claude.ai and Claude Code credentials and the in-container TLS certificate is self-signed.
Updates: GitHub Actions rebuilds the image whenever Anthropic publishes a newer claude-desktop .deb or a newer Claude Code CLI. Unraid compares the registry digest of :latest with your local image and offers "update ready"; the new container reuses the same appdata path, so your sign-in and CLI credentials survive.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the streamed desktop. 8080 is the only port the image serves; WebRTC/TURN ports are opt-in and never published. Do not forward this to the Internet.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Persistent desktop state: Chrome profile, keyring, Claude Desktop config and the Claude Code CLI credentials. The target must stay /home/ubuntu; do not change it to /config, which Unraid rewrites.

Config.Name: Workspace
Config.Description: Optional. A host folder with your projects, shown inside the container at /workspaces. Leave empty for none. Set WORKSPACE_GID if its group is not 1000.

Config.Name: WORKSPACE_GID
Config.Description: Optional. Group id that owns the workspace on the host (Unraid: 100, users). The session stays uid/gid 1000 and joins this group, so group-writable files are writable. Nothing on the host is chowned. Empty = off.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the session runs as. Must be 1000: the image is rootless at uid 1000 and exits 78 for any other value.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the session runs as. Must be 1000 for the same reason as PUID.

Config.Name: SELKIES_ENABLE_BASIC_AUTH
Config.Description: Require a login on the streamed desktop. Off by default: the reverse proxy is the gate. Set to true and set PASSWD to turn the ubuntu login on.

Config.Name: PASSWD
Config.Description: Login password for the streamed desktop (user name ubuntu). Read only when SELKIES_ENABLE_BASIC_AUTH is true.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for the desktop, as an IANA name such as Europe/Berlin. Matches compose CLAUDE_TZ.

Config.Name: SELKIES_MODE
Config.Description: Transport for the stream. websockets needs no extra ports. Setting webRTC also requires TURN ports 3478 and 65532-65535 to be published, which this template deliberately does not do.

Config.Name: FORCE_AUTOUPDATE_PLUGINS
Config.Description: Keeps plugin auto-update on, so the mods in this image update without a rebuild. The image turns off Claude Code's own updater, and that switch also turns off plugin updates; this one keeps the plugin updates. Leave at 1.
